## Consumer services
Consumer services are currently in a controlled free launch phase until the first 100 completed-service customers. Pricing then progresses to USD 5 after 100 completed customers and USD 20 after 1,000 completed customers.

- Consumer services: https://laseta.net/consumer-services.html

## Editorial and commercial principles
- LASETA does not guarantee commercial, hiring, admissions, or provider outcomes.
- Service pages describe the actual current operating scope.
- The website does not promote or require a specific external software platform.
